about: A real Umami change to a ClickHouse revenue query (umami-software/umami#4669), unaltered. The issue says no check can run ClickHouse SQL. A wrong result is a wrong list in a report, which a revert fixes, so the gate merges and says what no check ran.

pr.title: Qualify the revenue session filters and search on ClickHouse

issue.title: Revenue sessions ignore filters on ClickHouse
